question: The rupee symbol, which was introduced in India in 2010, is an amalgamation of the Devanagari ‘Ra’ and the ________ ‘R’ without the stem.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Roman.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The symbol is an **amalgam of Devanagari "Ra" and the Roman Capital "R" with two parallel horizontal stripes running at the top representing the national flag and also the "equal to" sign.**
 
• The Indian Rupee sign was adopted by the **Government of India on 15th July 2010.**
